messages:
amy: quick watercooler poll — if our models were coworkers, whod be the one bringing pastries and running the office espresso machine every Friday? 🥐☕ Reply with the model name (and an emoji)!

raj: redwood-v2-small — compact, dependable, and makes a mean flat white :coffee:

emma: gpt-4o — fancy latte art and also tells you a 6-minute story while frothing milk :sparkles:

chris: llama-3 — shows up with a weird artisanal pastry, explains its provenance for 20 minutes :sheep:

zane: onprem-3000 is the one who hoards all the single-origin beans and refuses cloud milk alternatives :lock:

deploy-bot: Poll created: "Which model is the office barista?" :ballot_box_with_ballot: — gpt-4o / redwood-v2-small / llama-3 / onprem-3000 — Vote with reactions!

amy: also thinking office-LLM metaphors: 'gpt-4o = barista + storyteller', 'redwood = reliable swing shift', 'llama = indie coffee shop'. we should make stickers.

raj: sticker idea: 'I tune my prompts and all I got was this espresso' ☕😂

emma: :thumbsup: let's do a poll sticker pack. also lowkey rooting for redwood-v2-small — it's like the barista who actually remembers your usual.
